# datadog_integration_openai_usage_and_costs_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog OpenAI Usage and Costs integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the OpenAI Usage and Costs integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the OpenAI Usage and Costs integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the OpenAI Usage and Costs integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from OpenAI Usage and Costs, keyed by dataflow ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `open_ai_usage_and_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth` (Attributes) The bearer token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--open_ai_usage_and_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--open_ai_usage_and_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.open_ai_usage_and_costs_integration_account_bearer_token_auth`

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `bearer_token`. Defaults to `"bearer_token"`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret token used to authenticate with OpenAI. Exactly one of `token` or `token_wo` must be set. Prefer `token_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret token used to authenticate with OpenAI. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Optional:

- `custom_tags` (String) Comma-separated list of custom tags applied to the data collected for this account, for example `team:ai,env:prod`.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `openai_cloud_cost_data` (Attributes) OpenAI organization costs, which you can analyze in [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/). See [collected data](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/saas_costs/?tab=openai#data-collected) for what is included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_cloud_cost_data))

Read-Only:

- `openai_usage_metrics` (Attributes) Organization usage metrics under the `openai.*` namespace, such as `openai.completions.*`, `openai.embeddings.*`, `openai.images.*`, `openai.moderations.*`, `openai.audio_speeches.*`, `openai.audio_transcriptions.*`, `openai.code_interpreter_sessions.*`, and `openai.vector_stores.*`. This dataflow is always on and cannot be turned off, so it appears only in responses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_usage_metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--openai_cloud_cost_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.openai_cloud_cost_data`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.

Read-Only:

- `status` (Attributes) Read-only collection status of a dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_cloud_cost_data--status))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--openai_cloud_cost_data--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.openai_cloud_cost_data.status`

Read-Only:

- `health` (String) Collection health of a single dataflow.
- `message` (String) Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the status was last computed.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--openai_usage_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.openai_usage_metrics`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data. Always `true`, because this collection cannot be turned off.
- `status` (Attributes) Read-only collection status of a dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_usage_metrics--status))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--openai_usage_metrics--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.openai_usage_metrics.status`

Read-Only:

- `health` (String) Collection health of a single dataflow.
- `message` (String) Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the status was last computed.
